intro: Football and surfing are El Salvador's most popular sports.

chapters.title: Football
text: El Salvador played at the 1970 and 1982 World Cups. Jorge 'Mágico' González is a legend who played in Spain.

chapters.title: Surfing
text: El Salvador has hosted world surfing championships.

items.title: Primera División
items.subtitle: Football
items.text: Alianza and FAS are big clubs.
